hypothesis: 毛利率/ROA/现金回报质量复合：gross profitability、ROA、CFO/assets、低杠杆与流动性，全部用 group_rank 分数相加，规避单位冲突；与现有 ROE/EBIT 价值池子机制不同

items.label: QUAL_COMP
items.expression: group_rank(ts_backfill((sales - cogs) / assets, 60), subindustry) + group_rank(ts_backfill(return_assets, 60), subindustry) + group_rank(-equity / assets, subindustry) + group_rank(ts_backfill(cashflow_op / assets, 60), subindustry)

items.label: QUAL_LOWLEV
items.expression: group_rank(ts_backfill((sales - cogs) / assets, 60), subindustry) + group_rank(-equity / assets, subindustry) + group_rank(current_ratio, subindustry)
